Project 01 · Power BI

Crime LA Investigation Analytics

An investigative Power BI platform built around real law-enforcement workflows. Investigators can select a case, identify its offenses, and surface related incidents by geography, time and offense similarity.

Live Dashboard ↗

Advanced DAX

Disconnected selectors, virtual tables, CALCULATE, REMOVEFILTERS and INTERSECT logic.

Geographic Analytics

Haversine distance calculations surface incidents inside investigator-defined geographic radii.

Temporal Analysis

±60-day investigation windows identify incidents occurring around the selected case date.

Many-to-Many Matching

Offense matching correctly handles incidents associated with multiple offenses.
